Since about 900AD all the way up until after 1900, human feces were one of the primary components of gunpowder. In the leadup to the Civil War, when the Union realized that most of the saltpeter mines were closed/closing in the North, they produced one of the most descriptive documents in history for the creation of gunpowder using feces and/or urine. Getting a head start on gathering and producing powder from poop was necessary for the war effort, as it takes 12-18 months to produce the nitrate needed.

So it can be argued that human feces helped end slavery in America.
